invariants.name: Canonical business state
invariants.prototypeCheck: fixture state is authoritative; projections are labelled

invariants.name: Person/application separation
invariants.prototypeCheck: candidate and application IDs are distinct

invariants.name: Active-application uniqueness
invariants.prototypeCheck: one active fixture attempt per job/person pair

invariants.name: Single primary stage
invariants.prototypeCheck: each active application exposes one primary stage

invariants.name: Controlled transition
invariants.prototypeCheck: only TRN IDs appear as governed stage actions

invariants.name: Human employment decision
invariants.prototypeCheck: decision action requires explicit human confirmation

invariants.name: Evidence/version integrity
invariants.prototypeCheck: fixture versions are visible in detail panels

invariants.name: Derived work is reproducible
invariants.prototypeCheck: why panels name source facts and freshness

invariants.name: Candidate-safe projection
invariants.prototypeCheck: candidate UI uses safe status and excludes internal evidence

invariants.name: Communication purpose
invariants.prototypeCheck: messages show purpose and suppression state

invariants.name: Replay-safe side effects
invariants.prototypeCheck: run view shows stable keys and duplicate handling

errors.name: Validation
errors.recovery: preserve input, identify field, allow correction

errors.name: Unauthenticated
errors.recovery: safe session restart without record disclosure

errors.name: Forbidden or not found
errors.recovery: generic safe response and support path

errors.name: Rate or capacity limited
errors.recovery: bounded retry with accessible wait guidance

errors.name: Dependency unavailable
errors.recovery: owned fallback and no false completion

errors.name: File unsafe or pending
errors.recovery: quarantine state and alternative support route

errors.name: Policy unknown or blocked
errors.recovery: stop action and create attributed review

errors.name: Unexpected
errors.recovery: correlation reference, safe copy and owned recovery
